lines.en: : {i}I was positive this would come down to a battle of calico vs. golden retriever. I hadn’t even assigned an animal to Makoto yet.{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You should look into breeding. I’d pay a great deal for one of your puppies.{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I’m feeling strangely embarrassed right now.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我现在感到一种奇怪的难为情。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You’re really cute and I like you a lot.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你真的很可爱，我很喜欢你。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Please stop. I don’t like it.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}请别说了。我不喜欢。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I can’t stop thinking about tenderly kissing you on the forehead right now.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我现在满脑子都是想轻轻亲一下你的额头。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I need to go. Goodbye.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我得走了。再见。{/i}
